d: The war in West Asia is heating up again. Iran claims it has targeted American military assets in Kuwait, while Bahrain says it has intercepted Iranian attacks. The U.S. has struck an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island, close to the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. With Washington deploying a third aircraft carrier group, tensions are rising. But what happened to diplomacy? As Tehran and Washington dig in over sanctions, frozen funds and control of the Strait of Hormuz, is another round of fighting inevitable?
